China’s foreigner surveillance exposed: How a database tracked passports, trips and daily lives
results.description: A cybersecurity researcher searching for evidence of China’s surveillance systems found something unexpected earlier this year when he discovered his own photograph, passport number and old Chinese mobile number in a database used to monitor foreign nationals. Marc Hofer, the researcher who previously worked as a foreign correspondent in the country, discovered the information while [...]
